physical_subject: How can two straight sliding tracks draw an ellipse?
relationship: A point dividing a rod between perpendicular sliders has coordinates a cos theta and b sin theta; equal distances produce a circle.
operation: A fixed bar carries an off-center pencil around an ellipse, then a centered pencil around a circle.
closest_prior: quiet/01-ellipse: focal-distance and reflection; old Tusi couple: circle rolling inside circle
substantive_difference: A rigid bar with perpendicular sliders generates an ellipse through unequal projections, then an internal midpoint generates a circle; no focal reflection or rolling-circle mechanism.
